operator_processing_approval.operation: approve_processing_consent for this exact owner and consent only

worker_installation_and_start.scope: Install only the new dedicated deployment and two reviewed units; launch this one owner-scoped controller within the fixed window, subject to all preflights; verify the normal website sample workflow; stop only this worker/controller before expiry

required_preconditions: Verified EC2 receipt and all read-only host checks pass
Original protected upload whole-row hash unchanged and permanent exclusion retained
Separate operator processing approval recorded with the exact expiry
Fresh actual cgroup quotas and per-generation live denial proofs before queue/model access
activation_manifest_changes_after_author: operator_approved: false to true only after actual authorization
approval_reference: bind the actual user authorization to this candidate hash; record resulting active manifest hash
preserve: Existing Noethara and Supabase containers, configuration and volumes
Original upload and all old/ineligible jobs
excluded_operations: Shared-host reboot, Docker restart or existing-service restart
expiry_policy: Fixed UTC window; no automatic extension, renewal, rescheduling or approval. If missed, prepare a new candidate for separate review.
rollback: Revoke this deployment grant, write its durable revocation marker and gracefully stop only the matching new controller/container. Preserve isolation rules, model assets, evidence and queued work.
